Preserve the ship-owned totalRelevantEnginePower and maximumContinuousRatingPower inputs according to the COMPLETE contract without replacing the former with the latter, and retain recommendedChestVolume as an approximate derived result using tolerance scaled from the expected totalRelevantEnginePower/750 value.
